jobs.title: Software Development Engineer (Database) Early Career- 2027 (US)
jobs.description: There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon. At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure? What’s in it for you? With teams across the Amazon universe, you don’t have to choose one path too early. You’ll take ownership, build new skills, and shape a career that evolves as you do Key job responsibilities Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward. Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation. Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team. Conduct code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness. Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation. Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output. Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns. Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Optiver is looking for Software Engineers to join our High-Frequency Trading (HFT) team in Austin. Our engineers work at the intersection of research-driven trading, machine learning, ultra-low-latency software and custom hardware to build fully automated trading systems operating across global markets. As a Software Engineer, you'll work directly with traders, researchers and hardware engineers to solve complex technical challenges, develop new trading strategies and build the systems that bring them to production. Our teams own problems end to end, from data ingestion, feature generation and simulation through to high-performance C++ and FPGA-based execution. We're continuing to expand into new markets, products and strategies, creating opportunities to build new systems, influence technical direction and see your work directly impact live trading across the world. What you'll do Partner closely with traders and researchers to develop and improve research-driven, machine learning-based trading strategies. Build and optimize trading infrastructure across the full lifecycle, from data ingestion, feature generation and simulation through to production execution. Solve challenging performance problems across ultra-low-latency C++, software architecture and FPGA-based trading systems. Design and develop scalable research infrastructure that enables rapid experimentation, backtesting and deployment of new strategies. Push frequent, impactful code changes into production, with direct visibility into their performance in live markets. Contribute to the technical direction of our trading systems as we expand into new markets, products and strategies. Develop a deep understanding of market microstructure, trading and exchange behavior. What you’ll get You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem-solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, collectively tackling some of the toughest challenges in the financial markets. In addition, you’ll receive: The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 40 different countries A highly competitive compensation package Global profit-sharing pool and performance-based bonus structure 401(k) match up to 50% Comprehensive health, mental, dental, vision, disability, and life coverage 25 paid vacation days alongside market holidays Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and snacks, regular social events, clubs, sporting leagues and more Who you are Strong engineering instincts and a deep understanding of computer science fundamentals. C++ experience preferred, ideally in performance-critical systems such as low-latency trading, market data processing, execution systems or simulation frameworks. An interest in solving complex performance challenges, whether through software optimization, systems design or hardware/software integration. Innovative, out-of-the-box thinking grounded in real-world pragmatism. A desire to continuously improve, learn and solve challenging problems in a rapidly evolving environment. Readiness to take ownership, influence technical direction and uphold high engineering standards. Experience with Python, Linux, distributed systems or machine learning infrastructure is a plus. Who we are Optiver is a tech-driven trading firm and leading global market maker. As one of the oldest market making institutions, we are a trusted partner of 70+ exchanges across the globe. Our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets for everyone who participates. Based in ‘The Domain’ neighborhood, Optiver’s Austin office serves as the firm’s innovation nucleus, with a strong focus on quantitative research, software and hardware engineering initiatives. With tech innovation an integral part of our core business, the booming city proved an ideal backdrop for our heavy investment into machine learning, research infrastructure and big data computing. What’s more, with world-class music, food and art scenes, as well as countless scenic outdoor activities, the quality of life for Austin Optiverians is second to none. Our differences are our edge. Optiver does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, or other legally protected characteristics.
